newsitem.title: USA: United Foods amends tender offer.
newsitem.headline: United Foods amends tender offer.

text.p: United Foods Inc said it is amending its cash tender offer for shares of its Class A and Class B Common Stock by extending the expiration date and by increasing the number of shares it is offering to purchase.

The company is increasing the number of shares it is offering to purchase up to 2.5 million shares of its Class A common stock and up to 1.5 million shares of its Class B common stock. Originally, the offer was for 1 million shares of its Class A and Class B common stock.
The price remains at $2.50 per share.
The offer will now expire at 1700 EDT on July 3. Initially, it was to have expired at 1700 EDT on June 17.

As of 1600 EDT on Tuesday, a total of 2,433,855 shares of Class A Common Stock and 1,639,402 shares of Class B Common Stock had been validly tendered and not withdrawn in response to the original offer.
